title: Iraq gimbal thermal video by Marine
summary: Merrick tells of Iraq gimbal thermal video by Marine, about 2008 at Iraqi desert, ~100 miles from Syrian border, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Iraqi desert, ~100 miles from Syrian border

tellings.quote: Um but I'll just tee it up first. Jeremy got an interview with the the Marine who actually recorded this. This was a in 2008. Uh and he's in a what's called a LAV Lav 25.

plain: A guest named Merrick, on a Jesse Michels episode challenging the UFO skeptic Mick West to a debate, describes a heat-camera video of an unexplained object filmed in Iraq. He says filmmaker Jeremy Corbell interviewed the Marine who recorded it in 2008, in the desert about 100 miles from the Syrian border, from an eight-wheeled armored vehicle called a LAV-25. Hearing from the person who filmed it would give the video a firsthand witness.
